name: UGC 11131 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 11131, a low surface brightness galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc11131-hubble
story: A galaxy whose stars spread so thinly that its disk barely glows. Hubble searched it for globular clusters, which can reveal how such faint galaxies formed and evolved.

claims.text: UGC 11131 is a low surface brightness (LSB) galaxy targeted by HST program 10550
The program's targets are massive LSB galaxies, with masses roughly of the Milky Way or above
Globular clusters constrain how LSB galaxies formed and evolved
